next.reason: 1985: after the USE procedure, if the I-O status 'does not indicate a critical input-output error' control returns to the next executable statement after the I-O statement; otherwise 'the implementor determines what action is taken'. 2023 format 1 USE: if the status does not indicate a fatal EC-I-O exception condition, 'control is returned to an implicit CONTINUE statement following the input-output statement whose execution caused the exception', otherwise the implementor determines the action (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR7). The MERGE/SORT case only defers to those statements. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR12 governs format 3 USE (exception-names), not this format, so it is not a counterpart. Same effect.
